detailed_descriptions.en: Take part in the fight for humanity's freedom in AI Olympius! Join the resistance and conquer the top of Olympus of artificial intelligence that has equated itself with a god in a story-driven third-person shooter with RPG elements. Variability of the world The game's missions take place across different parts of the planet, so each sector differs from the previous one. The game offers 30 campaign missions and about 35 hours of gameplay. Rebel technologies Collect resources, develop your character, improve your skills, and unlock new abilities to fight artificial intelligence. The game offers over 60 weapon and costume modifications Play together The game supports two-player co-op in split-screen mode on the same computer or a simple network connection. Mind control Capture enemy robots, or make allied machines right on the battlefield. Base building Create, defend, and improve your base to extract resources in the additional game mode intertwined with the main storyline.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Take part in the fight for humanity's freedom in AI Olympius!

Join the resistance and conquer the top of Olympus of artificial intelligence that has equated itself with a god in a story-driven third-person shooter with RPG elements.

Variability of the world

The game's missions take place across different parts of the planet, so each sector differs from the previous one.

The game offers 30 campaign missions and about 35 hours of gameplay.

Rebel technologies

Collect resources, develop your character, improve your skills, and unlock new abilities to fight artificial intelligence.
The game offers over 60 weapon and costume modifications

Play together

The game supports two-player co-op in split-screen mode on the same computer or a simple network connection.

Mind control

Capture enemy robots, or make allied machines right on the battlefield.

Base building

Create, defend, and improve your base to extract resources in the additional game mode intertwined with the main storyline.
